Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A job report showing mixed signals: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, hearty rösti, chocolate fondue). Warm rustic interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction to your personal site, and I like that it keeps things simple and direct. A couple of suggestions to make it even more engaging: add a bit more about who you are and what you do (your interests, work, or projects), and consider including a few photos or links to your other profiles so visitors can get a fuller picture. Overall, a friendly and welcoming site — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that it centers on hiking — it's a great topic, and the personal touch makes the blog feel warm and approachable. To make it even more interesting, you could add some recent hiking stories or photos from your adventures, share trail recommendations or gear tips, and maybe include a short intro so readers know a bit more about you and your hiking experience. Looking forward to reading more!
